verses.text: Be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have.
verses.title: Ready for Christ’s Return

verses.text: May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, Lord , my Rock and my Redeemer.
Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
